name: SLS Buenos Aires Puerto Madero
insider_take: This sleek SLS property brings Miami Beach glamour to Buenos Aires' most cosmopolitan waterfront district, where converted brick warehouses meet cutting-edge architecture.
whats_special: Located in Puerto Madero, Latin America's largest urban renewal project, this hotel sits in the only Buenos Aires neighborhood planned with a grid system. The area was transformed from abandoned docks into a prestigious district featuring the iconic Puente de la Mujer bridge designed by Santiago Calatrava, which rotates to allow ships to pass through.
pro_tip: Book a room facing the Río de la Plata for stunning sunset views, and time your arrival with the Puente de la Mujer's rotation schedule – it's a mesmerizing sight that happens several times daily.
dont_miss: The nearby Reserva Ecológica Costanera Sur, a 865-acre nature preserve that's home to over 200 bird species, and the Fragata Sarmiento museum ship – a beautifully preserved 1898 training vessel that's now a maritime museum just steps from the hotel.
pros: Prime Puerto Madero waterfront location with stunning river views
Contemporary luxury design with sophisticated SLS brand aesthetics
Exceptional dining options and vibrant rooftop bar scene
Full-service spa and state-of-the-art fitness facilities
cons: Modern design may not suit traditional luxury preferences
